title: Every file OpenMW reads, as one configuration
description: The crate walks the same chain OpenMW does, keeps track of which file said what, and writes changes back to the file that owns them.

nodes.title: Root openmw.cfg
nodes.detail: Beside the executable, or the platform's global config. A package's root usually ends with config="?userconfig?".

nodes.title: The chain
nodes.detail: config= entries load depth first, as OpenMW's loader walks them. replace= discards what came before, tokens resolve, relative paths anchor to their own file.

nodes.title: OpenMWConfiguration
nodes.detail: Content files, data directories, archives, fallback settings and unknown keys, each tagged with its source file and comment.

nodes.title: User openmw.cfg
nodes.detail: The last file loaded: the one the launcher edits, and the one save_user() writes.

nodes.title: Lua scripts
nodes.detail: A Rust host registers openmwConfig, and scripts get the same model through a camelCase API.
